title: ci: add artifact signing, SBOM generation, and release provenance manifests for private-installer
author: Aisha Khan
description: Add CI steps and release artifacts for Private Installer: SBOM (syft), cosign signing, and release provenance manifests. This PR wires artifact generation into the existing release pipeline, emits reproducible provenance metadata and SBOMs, and signs release blobs with cosign. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private require verifiable supply-chain artifacts (SBOM + signature + provenance) for air-gapped and regulated environments. The changes include new pipeline jobs, a small helper utility that collates build metadata into a canonical release-manifests.json, and updates to the private-installer release script to upload signed artifacts and attach provenance. Checklist: - [x] Generate SBOM for installer images (syft) - [x] Produce release_provenance.json with build inputs, git refs, builder image digests - [x] Sign artifacts with cosign (keyless + KMS fallback) - [x] Publish artifacts to release bucket and attach manifests - [x] Validate artifact verification during integration job - [x] Update docs with verification steps (private-installer/README) Notes: This is intentionally conservative: artifacts are signed after the canonical release manifest is produced to ensure deterministic provenance. The cosign step supports both keyless and KMS-backed signing depending on release credentials. The SBOMs are generated per-image and per-archive to support air-gapped verification. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and follow-ups.
commits: feat(ci): add syft sbom generation job for private-installer images
feat(ci): emit release_provenance.json and canonical manifest collator
chore(ci): add cosign signing step and KMS integration
fix(release): ensure archive checksums are recorded in manifest
file_snippets: ci/scripts/generate-provenance.sh: #!/usr/bin/env bash\n# collate git ref, builder image digest, input artifacts into release_provenance.json\necho '{\"git_ref\": \"$GIT_REF\", \"builder_digest\": \"$BUILDER_DIGEST\", \"inputs\": []}' > release_provenance.json
ci/scripts/sign-artifacts.sh: cosign sign --key k8s://projects/ci/secrets/cosign || cosign sign --keyless --annotation ci-job=$GITHUB_RUN_ID $ARTIFACT

release_notes: Add artifact signing, SBOM generation, and release provenance manifests for Private Installer. Enables verifiable, signed releases for air-gapped and regulated customers; documents verification steps.
notes_for_ops: Operators should provision cosign/KMS credentials for release runner; verification steps added to docs/private-installer/verification.md. The release job expects GCS_RELEASE_BUCKET and COSIGN_KMS_KEY env vars.
verification_steps: Run cosign verify --key <kms-key> OR cosign verify --keyless --signature <sig> <artifact>
Check SBOMs generated by syft against local image via syft packages <image>
Validate sha256 checksums in release_manifests.json match downloaded archives
